verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships a self-hosted MCP server (with OAuth 2.0 support) that lets AI agents interact with BugSnag data/actions, which is the main hook for natural-language operation, but there's no evidence of a built-in chat/NL command interface within the product itself — it relies entirely on external AI agents connecting via MCP. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of natural-language command support, examples of NL-driven workflows, and independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's usability.
